question: List all measurements in epoch 999999.
graph_cypher:
MATCH (m:Measurement)-[:EPOCH_IN]->(e:Epoch {epoch_id: 999999})
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sensor)-[:GENERATED]->(m)
RETURN coalesce(s.mote_id, m.moteid, m.mote_id) AS mote_id, m.time AS time, m.temperature AS temperature, m.humidity AS humidity, m.light AS light, m.voltage AS voltage
ORDER BY m.time ASC, mote_id ASC
LIMIT 20
